SUBARU-PUT_BACK.text: Put back on top of your draw pile
SUBARU-REMOVE_CURSE.text: Choose Status or Curse cards to Exhaust
SUBARU-DREAM_PROMPT.text: Choose cards to Exhaust (each deals damage to ALL enemies)
SUBARU-STATUS_LOLIMANCER: Lolimancer: at the start of each turn, choose 1 of [E·M·T] and [E·M·M] to add to your hand, then lose 1 stack.
SUBARU-STATUS_MADNESS: Madness: Energy -1, play at most 3 cards per turn, Return by Death is disabled. When gained, each stack also grants 1 [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
SUBARU-STATUS_FRAGRANCE: [gold]Witch's Scent[/gold]: each stack increases damage you take by 1%. Every Return by Death adds more.
SUBARU-STATUS_FLOAT: Float: each stack halves damage you take.
SUBARU-STATUS_MIASMA: [gold]Witch Miasma[/gold]: Curse. Unplayable, [gold]Retain[/gold]. Lose 1 HP at end of turn while it is in your hand. Each Return by Death grants 20 [gold]Witch's Scent[/gold].
SUBARU-STATUS_PRIDE: [gold]Pride[/gold]: the stacks you carry. Granted by your starter relic at combat start; each Return by Death also grants Strength and Dexterity (Sin Archbishop of Pride grants more).
SUBARU-STATUS_SLOTH_FACTOR: [gold]Sloth Factor[/gold]: at the start of each turn, add 1 [True Unseen Providence] to your hand.
SUBARU-STATUS_GREED_CONTRACT: [gold]Greed Contract[/gold]: turn start +1 Energy and draw 1. Turn end: [gold]Retain[/gold] up to 2 cards and gain 10 [gold]Witch's Scent[/gold].
SUBARU-STATUS_BEATRICE: [gold]Beatrice[/gold]: a present state. Only cards with [Beatrice] can be played, and some of them cost 0.
SUBARU-BASIC_MAGIC_PROMPT.text: Choose a [gold]Basic Magic[/gold] card to add to your hand
SUBARU-STATUS_REWIND.text: [gold]Return by Death[/gold]: when you die, return to the savepoint (the start of combat, or the turn set by Lost). Every return adds [gold]Witch's Scent[/gold] and [gold]Witch Miasma[/gold].
SUBARU-STATUS_BASIC_MAGIC.text: [gold]Basic Magic[/gold]: only created by [gold]Court Jester[/gold]. Costs 0 and is [gold]Ethereal[/gold]; each element resolves its own effect.
SUBARU-STATUS_STUN.text: [gold]Stun[/gold]: the enemy cannot act on its next turn.
SUBARU-STATUS_UNBLOCKABLE.text: [gold]Unblockable[/gold]: damage that ignores [gold]Block[/gold] and is dealt directly to HP.
